title: The Old Wars: The Third

texts.details:
So the humans number their wars, and this is their third. For my people it was the second time the Legion came, and we had waited ten thousand years for it.

I will tell you how it ended, since you fight for the Alliance and should know what the word once meant. On Mount Hyjal there were three camps on one slope. The humans, under the sorceress Proudmoore, lowest. Above them the orcs, under Thrall. At the summit, my people. None could have held alone. Together we did not try to win. We tried only to be slow.

The humans fell first, then the orcs, then us. And when the demon lord Archimonde reached the World Tree at last, Malfurion sounded the Horn of Cenarius, and the spirits of the forest destroyed him. We gave our immortality for that hour.

Some of his host never left this world. They are at Mannoroc Coven, south of here. Six of their mage hunters. And their captain: Xarkoth.
texts.objectives: Kill 6 Mage Hunters and then Xarkoth at Mannoroc Coven in Desolace. Return to Vahlarriel Demonslayer at Nijel's Point.
texts.progress: They do not tire, and they do not doubt. You will have to be better than tireless.
texts.completion:
Xarkoth is gone. The Legion is one captain poorer, and does not even know it.

The Third War teaches the last thing a warrior learns. There are fights you cannot win, and you must make them anyway, because of what the holding buys. Every base on that mountain fell. Each one was meant to. The victory was in the time.

A warrior who can do that needs weapons that will not fail before he does. Choose one of these. They have seen that kind of work.

Two wars remain, and they are not behind us. For the one still being fought, go to the Plaguelands when you have fifty seasons. Chillwind Camp, on the border of the Western Plaguelands. Ask for Commander Ashlam Valorfist.

idea: The Old Wars, level 40 (Alliance): the Third War. From the wiki: at Mount Hyjal the coalition of Jaina's humans, Thrall's Horde and the night elves could not hold and aimed only to delay; the Alliance base fell first, then the Horde's, then the night elves'; Malfurion sounded the Horn of Cenarius and the wisps destroyed Archimonde at Nordrassil; the night elves lost their immortality. Invented: Xarkoth.
